Sentence (English): Bought this dishwasher several weeks ago.
Comments (English): [ Great product and installation. Terrible logistics ] || ---------------- || Bought this dishwasher several weeks ago. So far very happy with the dishwasher itself. Installer (who also delivered) was professional and did an excellent job. This one star review is for Costco.com Logistics.I purchased the dishwasher from the website. At the time of purchase, the site indicated that the dishwasher would be delivered 7 days later, and that I would receive an automated call from Costco.com Logistics the night before delivery with a delivery window, followed by a call from the delivery company approximately 30 minutes before delivery.I tracked the deliveries and saw that it had arrive at the distribution hub (40 minutes away) the day before the scheduled delivery. That night: no call. I spent the following day at home all day, waiting. No call from the delivery company. No delivery. No update to the delivery tracking. No communication of any kind. One day completely wasted.I called Costco.com logistics the day after the scheduled delivery. They had zero explanation for why the delivery had not occurred; they did not know. They were unable to contact the delivery company to find out what had happened. They were able to re-schedule the delivery for 5 days later. I was unhappy.Waited nearly another week. Night before the delivery: no call. Day of the delivery I received a tracking notification email stating that the dishwasher was out for delivery, no delivery window given. Spent that day at home all day, waiting. Finally at 5:15pm received a call from the installer stating that he was 45 minutes away.Installer arrived when he said he would, had all the parts needed (including an extension as the dishwasher is not right next to the sink), and did an excellent job on an install that was more difficult than normal. Very pleased with his manner and the install itself.Not happy that I spent another entire day waiting. Had I received the automated call the night before with a delivery window, I would not have wasted another entire day waiting for a delivery that would be made at 6pm.I understand delays. I really do. I don't like them, but I do understand them. In this case, there shouldn't have been a delay since the dishwasher was 40 miles away, but I can put that aside. It was not the delay that caused me to write this overly long review. It was the fact Costco.com Logistics could not tell me why it was delayed. It was the fact that Costco.com Logistics never communicated that it would be delayed. It was the fact that Costco.com Logistics did not reach out to me to reschedule the delivery. How long would the dishwasher have remained 40 miles away if I had not called them. It was the lack of coordination and communication by Costco.com Logistics that caused me to waste two days waiting, unable to leave home, unsure when or if the dishwasher would arrive. That is what is so upsetting.Costco.com Logistics needs to get their act together. They are Costco.com Logistics; logistics is all they do. Unfortunately, they don't do it very well.The only good thing I have to say about this experience with Costco.com Logistics is that it was better than when I purchased a refrigerator from Costco.com 2 years ago. And that is just sad.

Sentence (English): For the last 24 years of my life I have owned 3 Kitchen Aide Dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Buy the Most Extended Multi Year Warranty Offered ] || ---------------- || For the last 24 years of my life I have owned 3 Kitchen Aide Dishwashers. This will be my fourth unit I have purchased over that time. In terms of washing and drying dishes, it truly is an excellent machine. Just know that they are also plagued by extensive mechanical problems. I have had to replace main circuit boards, the entire washing assembly and a factory recall of multiple parts. An extended year maintenance plan will pay for itself many times over. In fact, my current dishwasher (the earlier version of this model), completely malfunctioned after 3.5 years into a 5 year warranty. This is the least amount of years I have gotten out of a KitchenAide dishwasher. The warranty company will be reimbursing me the entire original cost of the dishwasher and I will be applying it to this newer model. I know it sounds crazy to knowingly buy a machine that will have problems, but honestly, you can't beat how it performs in the meantime. No filters to clean, solid interior construction, all the features and versatility that you will ever be needed. I love this dishwasher model, it's been an absolute workhorse in our home.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is very disappointing.
Comments (English): [ Damages glassware and doesn't clean ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is very disappointing. I read reviews of dishwashers before shopping and then was swayed by the sleek, smoothly operating interior and the low noise level. LG seems to have a good reputation so I purchased LDTH797** (or LDPH797** --a top-level machine. From the very first load, I found utensils that were not clean, particularly knives. Then baking dishes with dried-on remnants that should have been easily removed. Now the latest are a set of Southern Living clear plastic tumblers that have looked great for 6 years, but now have scratch marks and cloudy spots all over them. (This, I just noticed in the last couple of washes. Some are worse than others, but I know they all looked good before I bought this dishwasher.) The attached photo of the tumbler shows the bumpy surface of the tumbler with cloudy areas, some on bumps and some on dimples, but definitely on the exterior. The scratches around the bottom are inside! Since pools of water gathered on inverted mugs, I had tried using high heat to dry, so I switched to Low Dry Boost when these marks appeared.It is frustrating to load the dishwasher. The top shallow rack is fairly useless since only the very lightly soiled will get clean. The upper rack for glassware does not have good spacing. Tumblers will fit and regualr coffee cups, but the narrow row that will hold juice glasses allows the glasses to fall over and hit each other. The middle row is so wide, only the widest items can safely be placed there.The lower rack is even worse. There are basically 3 sections. Plates and dishes fit in the outer two, but the middle is a wider spacing so anything put there is just sitting upside-down catching all the water spray and taking up more room.My previous dishwasher was a 13-yr-old Whirlpool; it cleaned very well and held everything steady and at an angle that allowed all to receive water spray. Unfortunately, Whirlpool did not get high ratings so I did not consider them again. I should have paid more attention to the rack design of the LG.Photos: bits of food splashed onto knife, upper rack inefficient spacing, cereal not removed from bowl, residue on glass, lower rack poor spacing of tines, cloudy marks on outside of tumber and scratches around inside of tumbler. No idea how this could happen, but was not there beforePros: very quiet, sleek exterior, racks slide smoothlyCons: Food left on some items then dried on by high heat. Water pools on the bottom of inverted cups and mugs.

Sentence (English): How smart is a slimline dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ This is my third 45cm dishwasher and they just get ] || ---------------- || How smart is a slimline dishwasher! This is my 3rd Bosch compact dishwasher and it fits perfectly into my 1960s home which has narrow kitchen cabinets. Each unit has just gotten better and thus latest series 6 is a delight - so easy to use - I usually only run the 1 hour wash cycle, it fits large dinner plates, wine glasses, bowls, pots and a fry pan. Everything comes out sparkling and my glassware is crystal clear. The look of stainless gives my kitchen a wow factor, I love the digital display, the door, baskets, tablet holder and rinse aid compartment operate beautifully and it's super quiet. We are a 2 person household, and I like that it holds everything we use in a day so that I can do just one wash and there's nothing left over. My previous 2 Bosch slimline dishwashers each lasted over 10 years and when it came time to buy again, well truly it was a no-brainer that I would be getting another Bosch, and really I would never 'chance it' with another brand because when you do your research you'll read a lot of horror stories about those cheaper alternatives. To sum up - it does what it says it will do; wash and dry all dishes quickly, thoroughly without a lot of noise or drama - just what I'm after. If you have an older home with a small kitchen, or you're a small household, this is the appliance that you need.

Sentence (English): We have had the 800 series washer for about a month now.
Comments (English): [ Commercial Strength Washer ] || ---------------- || We have had the 800 series washer for about a month now. We have run about 20 cycles so far. Here is a quick recap of the puts and takes: - This is a serious washer. I would say commercial strength. Very well engineered. - We wish the dryer was as hearty. It gets plenty hot inside the basin during the dry cycle. When we open the machine at any period after it has been completed, from 20 minutes to 4 hours later, we have residual moisture which concerns us about starting the machine before we exit for a weekend trip or longer. Who wants mildew smells on their clean dishes? - The delay start on this model only works with the app. Why? This is the worst design feature ever. The button is on the control panel, but it only works with the app. - The software to enable "delay start" is clunky and requires you to pair the phone with the unit twice. Once to get the app to work in general and a second time to enable "delay start" feature. This is clunky, not explained well in the app, and certainly not explained in the sales pitch at the appliance store. - The Bosch support team at the 800 # has been excellent. It may take a while to get through to them, but it is worth the wait. All have been well trained and excellent to work with. Overall, a strong washer. Wish it had the "door open" feature after the dry function is done like the lower 500 series model does, and wish the delay start feature worked right on the control panel.

Of course, Rocket Installation was cheaper. Really Rocket Installation. This is my second time, and I was impressed both times. They even collected the dishwasher that didn't drain, and they worked hard to remove the remaining water while collecting it, but I was so touched that I was very kind and didn't complain at all.^^ Thanks to them, I was able to travel comfortably~~ 1. One drawback - Liquid dishwasher detergent cannot be used. Only solid detergent is possible. I was completely satisfied with the installation, and there are no good things about this dishwasher, but the most inconvenient thing is that liquid dishwasher detergent cannot be used. They only say to use solid detergent. I hate it when solid detergent doesn't dissolve well and leaves residue, so I've been using liquid dishwasher detergent for years, but I have two extra bottles at home, and they say that liquid detergent cannot be used. It's easy for errors to occur and stop. I decided to use the liquid detergent that was left at home, so I put half the amount of liquid detergent in the detergent box. Then I put one 5g small solid dishwashing detergent in the one that came out of the exploration. It's half liquid, half solid. I've been using this method for 3 months now and there was no problem at all. I'm going to use up the liquid detergent that I bought before like this. After I use it all up, I'll buy only solid dishwashing detergent without worrying about residue or not. 2. Disadvantage 2 - There is no light rinse function. The existing SK Magic dishwasher had a 7-minute rinse function. I used it a lot, but this type of function is not there at all. It just has full wash cycles. This is my first LG dishwasher, so I don't know if this line doesn't have it or if it's a function that's only available in the more expensive line. When I have a small amount of dishes after breakfast, I put the dishes in the dishwasher and rinse them for 7 minutes, close the door, and then I put in the lunch and turn it on. It's perfect. It has a rinse-once function and it smells much less. Now that this function is gone, when I want to use it for a while, I just roughly rinse it by hand and put it in, but it's a little more cumbersome than the basic one^^;;; Except for the two things above, I'm overall satisfied^^ There was a slight discount event, so I bought it for around 660,000 won. ----------------------------------------------------------- This is an honest review of something I bought with my own money. Since I have to wash both the first and second floors, I always just run it as standard. I wash the dishes from dinner and put them in the dishwasher, and I wash the dishes from breakfast and run the dishwasher once. The technician told me that my cups are glass and are very thin and can break, so I wash the cups separately by hand. I usually wash the dishes after washing them, so it is convenient to use this way. If you use it without washing, you can soak rice paste or other contents stuck to the bowl in hot water and put them in, so you don't have to wash them at high heat, so you can save on electricity. Sentence (English): The Bosch 500 Series isn't just an appliance—it's a statement.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 500 Series Review: A Masterpiece of Performa ] || ---------------- || The Bosch 500 Series isn't just an appliance—it's a statement. A testament to German engineering and thoughtful design, this series strikes the perfect balance between high performance, innovative features, and a sleek aesthetic that seamlessly integrates into any home. Having used the Bosch 500 Series extensively, I can confidently say it's in a league of its own. Quiet Excellence Bosch understands that a home should be a place of peace, not clattering appliances. The 500 Series dishwasher, for instance, operates at an incredibly low decibel level—so quiet that you'll often forget it's running. Bosch's InfoLight cleverly projects onto the floor to let you know the cycle is active. This silent efficiency redefines the modern kitchen experience. Precision Cleaning with Unmatched Efficiency Where other brands promise clean dishes, Bosch delivers. The 500 Series incorporates PrecisionWash technology, featuring sensors that continuously scan the load and adjust the wash cycle accordingly. Coupled with the AutoAir Dry feature, dishes not only come out spotless but also dry—without wasting energy. You get crystal-clear glassware, sparkling cutlery, and spotless pots every time. It's not just cleaning; it's artistry. Space Designed Around You Bosch's RackMatic system is a game-changer. Adjusting the racks in the dishwasher to fit your unique load—be it bulky pans or delicate wine glasses—is effortless. For me, it's like having a custom-made solution for every wash, saving time, frustration, and ensuring that every item fits perfectly. Built to Last Bosch doesn't just manufacture appliances; they craft them to stand the test of time. The 500 Series showcases durability without compromise. From stainless steel interiors to quality materials and components, every detail reinforces Bosch's commitment to reliability. You're not just investing in a dishwasher or range; you're investing in years of consistent performance. Modern and Intuitive Design Beyond performance, Bosch's design philosophy shines through. Clean lines, premium finishes, and modern interfaces make the 500 Series look like a luxury addition to any home. Features are intuitive and user-friendly, ensuring you don't need a manual to unlock its full potential. Energy Efficient for the Future Bosch is as mindful of the environment as it is of performance. The 500 Series is ENERGY STAR certified, meaning it minimizes water and energy usage while maximizing results. For families who want to reduce their carbon footprint without sacrificing quality, Bosch delivers. Final Thoughts: Worth Every Penny If appliances were graded on artistry, precision, and performance, the Bosch 500 Series would earn a perfect score. It's the unsung hero of my kitchen—a quiet powerhouse that works smarter, not harder. With features that anticipate my needs, an elegant design that enhances my home, and reliability I can trust, it has exceeded every expectation. The Bosch 500 Series doesn't just do the job—it elevates it. This is more than an appliance; it's a promise of quality that makes everyday living simpler, cleaner, and undeniably better. Bosch has once again raised the bar, and for that, I give it my highest recommendation.

Sentence (English): The built-in oven is black, so I bought a Phoenix black dishwasher.
Comments (English): The built-in oven is black, so I bought a Phoenix black dishwasher. It's neat and nice. The staff is also friendly. But the tomato seasoning doesn't come off easily. Hmm, should I change the detergent? And even when it's dry, moisture remains on the dishes. It's 80% dry, but about 20% moisture remains. You have to wipe it with a dry cloth. But it's a hundred times better than washing dishes. ---- Additional review: After I changed the detergent, the seasoning comes off well. I'm using it with satisfaction. This level of moisture is okay. I hated washing dishes so much, but my quality of life has improved.
Comments (Original): 빌트인 오븐도 블랙이라 식세기도 페닉스 블랙 샀는데 깔끔하고 좋네요. 친절하시고요. 근데 토마토 양념 묻은게 잘 안지워지네요 음 세제를 바꿔봐야하나.. 그리고 건조해도 물기가 식기 위에 그대로 있어요. 80%건조 되고 20%정도 물기 남아있습니다. 마른 행주로 닦아줘야 됩니다.....  그래도 설거지 하는 것보다는 백배 낫습니다  ----  추가 후기 : 세제 바꾸었더니 양념이 잘 지워지네요. 만족하며 사용중입니다요 물기 이정도면 괜찮아요. 그동안 설거지 너무 하기 싫었는데 삶의 질이 높아졌어요....

Sentence (English): Washing dishes after work was always a headache, so I bought a 3-person Minix dishwasher!

Sentence (English): I was thinking about buying either a dishwasher or a clothes dryer.
Comments (English): [ Intuitive and convenient usage ] || ---------------- || I was thinking about buying either a dishwasher or a clothes dryer. I ended up buying a dishwasher for the convenience of washing dishes more frequently. My kitchen isn't very spacious, so I was worried about the location of the faucet, but the installer came and looked at the location and recommended a direction. So I installed it in that direction. When I asked if I could move it a little more, he said it's better to use the installed location if possible because of the risk of the hose bending. Also, there's no place to attach the exhaust hose to my faucet. No matter what I did, the suction cup wouldn't stick to the wall or stay in place. So, do you have silicone tape? I cut it and attached it to the back of the suction cup, and it's been fixed well and hasn't fallen off since. Of course, I cleaned both the suction cup and the sink with an alcohol swab before attaching it. I still need to improve my dishwashing Tetris skills a bit more ^_^, but so far it seems to be cleaning well and working well. However, you need separate dishwasher detergent, and they don't give you a sample of it when you buy it, so make sure to buy it in advance. They say that if you use your regular kitchen detergent, it will foam too much and cause the device to break.

Sentence (English): This washer was purchased to replace a decade old Siemens unit (which in itself replaced an earlier ASKO).
Comments (English): [ A good middle of the road performer. ] || ---------------- || This washer was purchased to replace a decade old Siemens unit (which in itself replaced an earlier ASKO). It was chosen due to the fact that it had a quick rinse and hold capability that was predominantly used with the last washer. It is a far more noisier washer with the detergent and rinse aid dispenser operation being particularly noticeable. There is a lot of noise being transmitted via the front door, obviously a need there for more soundproofing. The cutlery basket is oddly shaped with the bottoms of the individual compartments sloping inwards, limiting the volume available to, for example, thick handled knives. The control panel, in contrast to a bank of press buttons, in my opinion could be made more user friendly by the ability to remove wash cycles from the selection process. This would only present a smaller number of wash options instead of having to continually button press to get a wash cycle other than the last was used. I would, for example, programme in the rinse & hold and a longer wash as my 2 favoured cycles. Not having a top of cabinet water outlet means you have to be careful with placing large sized items in the top rack, they are likely to not be properly washed. A fold down rack would cost next to nothing to implement…………. The turbo drying function goes a long way to having dry dishes at the end of the cycle, with the door open function contributing. All in all a good second tier washer that hopefully will last another decade.

Sentence (English): I was deciding whether to buy a dishwasher or a clothes dryer, but I ended up purchasing a dishwasher for the convenience of doing dishes more frequently.
Comments (English): [ Intuitive and convenient usage ] || ---------------- || I was deciding whether to buy a dishwasher or a clothes dryer, but I ended up purchasing a dishwasher for the convenience of doing dishes more frequently. My kitchen isn't very spacious, so I was worried about the location of the faucet. However, the installation technician came to check the position and recommended a direction, so I had it installed in this direction. When I asked if it could be moved further, he advised that it is better to use the installed location as is to avoid the risk of the hose bending. Also, since there isn't really a spot on my faucet to mount the drain hose, the suction cup wouldn't stick to the wall or stay in place no matter what I tried. So, I cut a piece of silicone tape and attached it to the back of the suction cup; it holds well now and hasn't fallen off since. Of course, I cleaned both the suction cup and the sink thoroughly with an alcohol swab before attaching it. I still need to improve my Tetris skills with dishes, but so far, it cleans well and seems good. However, you need separate dishwasher detergent, and they don't give you samples when you buy it, so be sure to stock up on detergent in advance. They say that if you use the dishwashing detergent you normally use, it produces too much foam and breaks down.

(. And with no manual to refer to (unless you had printed one from the internet), you would not know where to touch the panel to turn the machine on & off.) Other than these shortcomings, it does clean our disher as we expected.

Sentence (English): Cleans well and is extremely silent, which is what you need with a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great with some very minor issues ] || ---------------- || Cleans well and is extremely silent, which is what you need with a dishwasher. We upgraded from a previous Bosch and I think the interface is slightly less intuitive. We mostly use the 60-minute wash. The dishes don't dry very well, because Bosch doesn't have a heated dry so it's very important to use rinse-aid. Again, I think the previous Bosch version did better at drying even without rinse-aid. Another minor issue is that there is no indicator for "clean" which the previous version had. So it's hard to tell if you forgot to start the dishwasher or it's done cleaning. A nice new feature is a light at the bottom which tells you that washing is in progress -- this is important because it is so quiet that it is hard to tell if it is on.

Comments (English): [ THE Diswasher ] || ---------------- || An Absolute Game-Changer! I've had my Bosch 800 Series dishwasher for a few months now, and I can honestly say it's the best appliance I've ever purchased for my kitchen. One of the standout features of the Bosch 500 Series is how quiet it is. I was initially skeptical because I've had dishwashers in the past that were so loud they would shake the whole kitchen. If I had to mention any downsides, I'd say that the longer wash cycles can be a bit much if you're in a hurry. It's quiet, efficient, and cleans like a dream. The drying performance alone makes it worth every penny. If you're looking for a high-quality, long-lasting dishwasher that gets the job done with minimal hassle, I can't recommend this model enough. Bosch has definitely earned my loyalty with this purchase!

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher to replace a top of the line Bosch that was about 5 1/2 years old.
Comments (English): [ Dishes come out clean ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher to replace a top of the line Bosch that was about 5 1/2 years old. The Bosch has had over $600 worth of repairs in its lifetime and was not working correctly and was in need of more repairs. I got this Whirlpool on sale for $600. If I end up hating this Whirlpool and need to get a new dishwasher in a couple years, it's still more cost effective than the Bosch. The Whirlpool is cleaning so much better than the old dishwasher. Dishes come out sparkly clean. The Bosch had not been cleaning well for about 6+ months. The racks were completely rusted out. Note: I would not consider this Whirlpool quiet at all. If the Bosch gets a 5/5 for quietness, this dishwasher gets a 2/5, maybe. Also compared to the Bosch the racks and sprayer arms have a much flimsier feel. However, at this price point, I just want something that cleans my dishes for a few years.

Sentence (English): Very nice dishwasher, quiet, gets dishes clean.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, Reliable, Short Wash Cycle Is Great ] || ---------------- || Very nice dishwasher, quiet, gets dishes clean. This is for a lower/midrange Bosch unit (300 series). We have been trusting Bosch dishwashers for ~20 years, we haven't been let down. It is WiFi controllable, that's cool if you're into that. We are, but on the other hand, you know that from when you press Clean, in 1-2 hours you'll have clean dishes. When we're in a hurry, like company is coming in an hour, the quick cycle gets the job done as long as dirt hasn't caked on overnight. One minor irritant: There is no Quick Start for Idiots guide printed on the top panel when the dishwasher front is open. The quick wash cycle isn't 100% apparent. Also if you need to press a Start button or just close the door. Never mind that no one else does, or that Bosch changes the terminology over the years. You can install the dishwasher yourself if, say, you have the skills to do a spring tuneup on your lawnmower. Read carefully how to locate the water line, which includes a filter. Don't rush the job, make sure you identify which screws go where. We are short one of the two screws that holds on the black toekick panel. I bet it will never get installed.

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. When purchasing electronics from Coupang, I always feel secure because they take responsibility for everything from delivery to installation and after-sales service. With a 2-year free warranty and direct after-sales service provided by Coupang's own branches, I can purchase with confidence. Furthermore, there is a dedicated customer center, so any inconveniences can be resolved immediately. They kindly answered my product inquiries, and the installation technician was also very friendly; I am satisfied. Unlike other sites, the ability to specify a desired delivery date and the fact that they cover even the cost of a ladder truck free of charge are real advantages. Since it is a 6-person capacity model, the product size is slim, and although it features a two-tier basket, the interior space is ample, so I do not feel cramped at all. Because it is a window-type door, I can check the washing progress inside immediately, and since the door opens automatically when finished, it is very convenient because hot steam is released automatically even if I finish while doing other tasks. They say you must use the dedicated detergent. I think that is the only thing you need to be careful about. Before using it, I actually thought that for simple tasks, doing them by hand would be faster and simpler, but... Now that I've actually used it, I really understand why everyone wanted to buy a dishwasher. I think it would be so inconvenient without one. ^^ There were many times when washing dishes was a hassle, especially when I just had one or two dishes with some grease on them, but it is so convenient because they get cleaned perfectly just by putting them in the dishwasher.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.전자제품을 쿠팡에서 구매하면, 배송부터 설치 as까지 쿠팡에서 책임져주기때문에 항상 든든합니다.2년 무상보증에 쿠팡직영에서 직접 AS를 진행해주기때문에 믿고 구매할 수 있습니다.거기에 전담고객센터가 있어서 불편사항이 있더라도 바로바로 해결가능합니다.제품관련 문의도 친절하게 답변해주시고 설치기사님도 아주 친절하시고 만족합니다.다른사이트와 다르게 희망 배송일지정이 가능하다는 점, 사다리차 비용까지 다 무상지원하다는 점이 정말 장점입니다.6인용이라 제품사이즈가 슬림하고, 2단 바스켓으로 되어 있지만 내부공간은 넉넉해서좁다는 느낌은 전혀 못받고 있습니다.창문형 도어타입이라 내부 설거지 상황을 바로바로 확인할 수 있고 끝나면 자동으로 문이 열리기 때문에다른일하는 동안 끝나더라도 자동으로 열리면서 뜨거운 수증기가 배출되기 때문에아주 편리합니다. 전용 세제를 사용해서 꼭 사용해야한다고 합니다.그것 하나만 주의해주면 될 것 같습니다. 사용하기전에는 사실 간단한건 직접 손으로 하는게 더 빠르고 간단하지 않나 싶었는데,막상 써보니까 왜 다들 식기세척기 사고 싶어했는지 너무 잘 느끼고 있습니다.이제는 식기세척기 없으면 너무 불편할것같네요..^^  간단하게 그릇 1-2개있고 그런데 기름기가 있을때는 설거지하기 번거로운적이 많았는데 세척기에 넣으면 깨끗하게 닦이니 아주 편합니다.

Sentence (English): Run away!
Comments (English): [ DO NOT BUY. Save up $ until you can afford better. ] || ---------------- || Run away! Save up money for a few more months if necessary so you can spend more. This dishwasher is worthless. I have to run a single load of dishes TWO to THREE times to get them clean - and even then, things like a lip mark on a glass, a dry film in a teacup (I can remove with a finger swipe), or a measuring cup that had been used for cocoa powder remain. Flatware is filthy. still smears of yogurt or peanut butter. Glasses are streaky and filmy beyond just needing a polish. Yes, I use rinse aid. Yes, I literally fully rinse and lightly scrub dishes so they are almost clean and debris is loose and not dried on. Yes, I run the long cycle. I am a single person who does not even cook, so my dishes are only lightly used. I do not understand why this is so bad. I owned basically this same model for a few years until it started leaking. This one leaked the same way after installation and the installer said it was gunked up soap - after only the third cycle it had ever run. I can't afford to replace this right now, and I'm really upset. Wondering if they will stand behind it if it's a lemon and just give me a replacement. But I have no confidence in this.

Sentence (English): I bought this to replace a GE Profile with a serious design flaw resulting in repeated leaks from the bottom.
Comments (English): [ Samsung hits a home run with this high performer ] || ---------------- || I bought this to replace a GE Profile with a serious design flaw resulting in repeated leaks from the bottom. Since GE doesn't mean GE anymore, and Whirlpool/Maytag/KitchenAid/JennAir/Amana are all the same brand I wanted something different. I have become increasingly more of a fan of Samsung appliances (I now own a washer, dryer and dishwasher). I went with this model given my brother's experience with a Samsung dishwasher and the linear wash. Here is what I know having it about a month now (with nearly 2 cycles per day of use).I love it to start with. It is functional and has a lot of space inside. I went with the stormwash and have not regretted it. I have an InstantPot and often cook cheesy sticky food in it. My old dishwasher almost never cleaned it, in this one I put it over the nozzle and turn on stormwash and it comes out beautifully clean every time. I love the auto door open at the end, but unlike some models it pops open about 10-15 minutes BEFORE the cycle ends and continues to circulate air. My dishes come out so dry, lids with grooves will still hold a little water but it is pretty good. On that note, some Samsung models do not use hot air, this one does, which is a plus. On that note, the traditional dishwasher design has an exposed heating element at the bottom for drying, who among us hasn't had a piece of plastic fall during the cycle and melt on the element? Samsung hides the heating element safely inside the machine. Remember I said my last dishwasher would leak? Well we would come in to find puddles all over the floor and the machine would continue to pump. Samsung has a tray at the bottom to catch leaks, a sensor to shut the machine down, and thanks to Samsung SmartThings it would then alert me. On that note, I used to mock the idea of Wi-Fi enabled appliances, I now own several. I like that it alerts me when it is low on rinse aid, when the cycle is finished or if someone interrupts it, etc. It is so quiet that you don't even know it's there. I love this dishwasher and it has made me very happy with my choice. The ONLY issue I have is the cutlery basket. The slots are just a little too small for some of our Amazon Basics flatware, no worries. I used my multitool to enlarge the holes ever so slightly, but I would like to see the design incorporate slightly larger holes. I recommend this machine. Oh, I almost forgot. The water connection, instead of being in the front and requiring you to thread the tube under the machine and then fiddle with wrenches the connection is on the back, and Samsung uses a proprietary nut which you put on your existing elbow and it connects so much easier and better than the brass on plastic.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is exactly what it claims to be: whisper quiet, large capacity, great cleaner.
Comments (English): [ Sweet spot between cost and features ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is exactly what it claims to be: whisper quiet, large capacity, great cleaner. If you buy it and then bash it for not having the right tines or digital readouts or WiFi capability or doesn't dry plastic like a Bosch 800 for $400 more, that's on you for not doing your homework. The huge top rack is in a class of it's own. We use it all the time for small bowls, small cups, mixer attachments, etc. The space in the lower two racks is amazing. The middle rack is adjustable up and down to make room for really huge stuff but we haven't put anything in that would be that big. It easily swallows the largest crock pot bowl and other mixing bowls at the same time.The door opens lower than you are used to with your older dishwasher. In order to make the interior so huge, the engineers had to lower the floor which means the door hinges are farther down. Doesn't seem like much but it is noticeable when your muscle memory tells you to bend over this far to open the door all the way and now you have to bend over THIS far.44dBA is unnoticeable. You cannot hear this thing running unless there is a weird cup or something that the jets are hitting just right. Spending more because you don't think 44dBA is quiet enough? Wasted money.Blue light on the front tells you it's running, red light is drying, white light means done. If that's not enough info on what your dishwasher is doing, move along. A major reason I bought this model is because I don't want to have to use an app to unlock it's full potential.Some reviewers feel like it's just a blinged out Whirlpool. Guess what, if your repair guy can work on Whirlpool he can fix KitchenAid. Ask a repair guy which brands are their least favorite to work on. (Hint: It won't be Whirlpool/KitchenAid.) Not afraid to try your own repairs? The pumps and valves are on the front of the KitchenAid, meaning you don't have to pull the dishwasher out to troubleshoot it. Being a blinged out Whirlpool means you can get parts for it all day long. Not so with other brands. Don't take my word for it, ask around.Bottom line: This is a great dishwasher. Comments (English): [ 3 repair calls and still not working ] || ---------------- || I'll try and keep this short and concise.Six months in it started to make a burning smell. Checked the trap and it was clean as a whistle. First red flag.Red flag 2. Month ten, new error code E92-10, this error code is not listed on the manual, so I called up Bosch and they said it was a drainage issue and to call the repair company. When he called Bosch to order the part they couldn't give him a timeline for delivery. They said it was back ordered? Tech's best guess is 4 weeks. Still waiting on this fix. I asked the tech if I could keep using it since the top rack could still run and he said sure.Red flag 3. The functions and mode selection panel has a single 60 minute option. All other functions are non responsive. Will call the tech company on Monday and give them the bad news. I have to get this noted before the labor warranty expires.Red flag 4. When I called Bosch and asked if they could offer a replacement since this one has had multiple issues and been out of service over 2 months and the answer was a big fat NO. “ if it's repairable then you will have to wait.” With the holidays coming up, I asked about a temporary replacement and you guessed it “NO.”If I could give it no stars I would. Hopefully this is a one off bad dishwasher and no one else has any similar problems. I'll update this post when it's been fixed.

Sentence (English): This is my 4th personal dishwasher and I have two rentals that have gone through 3 others.
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher I've Ever Owned ] || ---------------- || This is my 4th personal dishwasher and I have two rentals that have gone through 3 others. One of my rentals came with a Bosch when I bought it 20 years ago and that dishwasher is still going strong. My Bosch 800 is AMAZING! If it wasn't for the red light that shines on the floor when it is running, I wouldn't know it was on. Yes it is that quite. If we are watching TV you cannot hear the dishwasher over the TV. I also love the 3rd rack. We no longer rinse our dishes before loading (we used to have to do that) and they come out clearer than our old Kemore Elite. The only 3 things I would want to see improvements on are 1. When you pull the bottom rack out if you don't pull straight out the rack easily comes off the guides built into the door. 2. I don't like the utensil bin, but it works 3. This is the biggest deal for me, is there's no signal on the machine to let you know if the dishes are clean or dirty. My old dishwasher had a green light that came on and stayed on until the door was opened and then fully closed after a cycle, so you knew if the dishes were clean. It would be easy enough for Bosch to add a green light that shines on the floor. There is an app for that, but not everybody in my family has the app on their phone. Bottom line, I LOVE This thing

Sentence (English): I bought a Bosch dishwasher because I was delighted with the quality of my previous devices (we have been using a hair dryer for 15 years, and a blender intensively for 5 years.)
Comments (English): [ My new Bosch series 2 dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I bought a Bosch dishwasher because I was delighted with the quality of my previous devices (we have been using a hair dryer for 15 years, and a blender intensively for 5 years.) Positive: it has an aquastop, the top shelf holds more dishes due to the better arrangement of the compartments, the dishes are perfectly washed, it is extremely quiet, it is easy to start and set the delayed start, it looks decisive. Exactly what I was looking for. Negative: the lower tub is not made of stainless steel (it looks cheap), the cutlery basket is too bulky - cast in one piece instead of being able to be separated. I left the old baskets from the previous machine. Small opening for pouring the glaze. The biggest drawback is that I did not get a 10-year warranty on the inverter motor, I was mistaken that this also applies to dishwashers.
Comments (Original): [ Moja nova sudomašina Bosch serie 2 ] || ---------------- || Kupio sam boš sudomašinu jer sam oduševljen kvalitetom predhodnih uređaja (15 godina koristimo fen, 5 godina koristimo intezivno blender...)Pozitivno: ima aquastop, Na gornjoj polici staje više sudova zbog boljeg rasporeda pregrada, sudovi perfektno oprani,izuzetno tiha, jednostavno se pokreće i podešava odloženi start, odlučan izgled... Baš ono što sam tražio...Negativno: donja kadica nije od inoxa (deluje jeftino), korpa za escajg preglomazna - livena iz jednog dela umesto da može da se razdvoji... Ostavio sam stare košare od predhodne mašine. Mali otvor za sipanje sjaja... Najveća mana je što nisam dobio garanciju 10 godina na inverter motor, bio sam u zabludi da to važi i za sudomašine.

I was given the name of the delivery company and told to call them. They told me that I had to call LG - they only responded to the direction of LG. It has been a frustrating and unpleasant experience. (I hope that the dishwasher doesn't have problems.)

Sentence (English): The KitchenAid dishwasher is great.
Comments (English): [ So far a great dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || The KitchenAid dishwasher is great. Dishes definitely come out looking clean and sparkly. We had just returned a GE dishwasher, Thanksgiving "deal", under $500. But luckily we talked with Lowe's appliances sales person who convinced us to buy the 50% more expensive, but worth it, Kitchenaid. So far, so good. The claim is that the noise level is 47 decibels. I doubt that is accurate. We had a Bosch dishwasher some years ago. You couldn't hear that one at all. Now, with our hearing worse as we have gotten old, you can certainly hear the Kitchenaid dishwasher. It is not terrible, but it is more than 47 decibels for sure (and not due to us forgetting the blanket, or anything like that). Just one gripe about the install - there wasn't a strain relief piece with the other odds and ends. We bought an install kit as well, but it wasn't there either. (It should come with the dishwasher). How frustrating to find that on Saturday night when the only close-by hardware store isn't open Sundays.

Once the dishwasher was hooked up, I discovered that the inside was MUCH smaller than the previous model; someone thought it was a good idea to hide the heating element in the sides therefore, I've lost about 40 square inches of space to place dirty dishes. I'm not looking forward to something breaking on my GE Profile refrigerator that I've had for 22 years, I certainly will not replace it with another GE product. Also, the screw holes for the kick plate would not line up with the holes for the screws on the dishwasher frame, and my old model had four adjustable legs made from metal, the newer model has plastic legs that are not very stable. I used wood blocks to help stabilize the new model.

The technician only took a day to schedule and install, and he was incredibly friendly. It seemed like Coupang was managing the entire service. They assured me that if a problem arose, I could report it right away and they'd fix it. As expected, delivery, installation, and after-sales service were all rockets! The technician was incredibly friendly. Installation itself only took about 30 minutes, so I was very satisfied. Overall Review: People like me considering this model when purchasing a dishwasher are probably looking for a reasonable price. Sentence (English): An honest review of the Media Auto-Open Dishwasher for 6 people!
Comments (English): [ A product I honestly recommend ] || ---------------- || An honest review of the Media Auto-Open Dishwasher for 6 people! This is my honest review of the Media Auto-Open Dishwasher, which I purchased while searching for a dishwasher. Its clean design. While the overall design of white appliances has been improving recently, I've occasionally encountered appliances with designs that feel somewhat lacking in person. However, I absolutely loved this product's clean design. I chose white, and it blended seamlessly into our all-white kitchen, without disrupting the overall look. I really appreciated the clean design. Perfect cleaning power. No matter how pretty a dishwasher is, if it doesn't clean the dishes properly, it's a disappointment. It actually exceeded my expectations, and I was pleasantly surprised. I loaded it with dishes from kimchi fried rice and fried eggs, and they cleaned perfectly, beyond my expectations. I used the standard mode, but the automatic mode adds an extra pre-wash, so if you're worried about the dishes being washed properly, you can use the automatic mode. Even on the standard mode, the cleaning power was more than adequate. Ample storage space. We're a two-person household, so we don't usually have a lot of dishes to wash at once. However, we had guests over, and we had dishes for eight people. I was worried about how much would fit, but there was plenty of storage space. Thanks to this, even large pots and pans can be washed in the dishwasher without any problems. Of course, large pots like cauldrons might be difficult to clean, but it's easily big enough to hold a kimchi stew pot and appetizers for six people. The automatic door opening system was the biggest reason I chose this model. When the washing cycle is finished, the door automatically opens and ventilation begins. The technician explained that this feature was added to the latest model. Many people often struggle with mold and water stains caused by accumulated steam and water in their dishwashers. This model, however, opens the door and ventilates at the end, making maintenance much easier. The technician also advised me to leave the door wide open to allow it to air dry to minimize the risk. Please keep this in mind! The friendly and convenient after-sales service was the most surprising part of the experience! Unless it's a major brand, the biggest concern is after-sales service issues when it breaks. I bought a truckload of appliances at a low price and then broke and threw them away. So, I was really worried, but surprisingly, I didn't have to worry. The technician only took a day to schedule and install, and he was incredibly friendly. It seemed like Coupang was managing the entire service. They assured me that if a problem arose, I could report it and they'd fix it right away. As expected, delivery, installation, and after-sales service were all rockets! The technician was incredibly friendly. Installation itself only took about 30 minutes, so I was very satisfied. Overall, anyone considering this model when purchasing a dishwasher, like me, is probably looking for a reasonable price. This model strikes a perfect balance between cost-effectiveness, value for money, and after-sales service. Highly recommended!

Comments (English): [ I highly recommend it. ] || ---------------- || I am truly satisfied considering the price. My old dishwasher broke down, so I bought a new one. I hadn't used it for a little over a week, and it was exhausting. They kindly delivered it exactly on the day and time I wanted, and they carefully checked all the precautions and notes. I heard the standard cycle uses less electricity, so I ran the standard high-temperature drying cycle yesterday. When I checked this morning, everything was fluffy and clean. (They say the standard cycle uses the least electricity and cleans the best. They mentioned that the 1-hour cycle uses a bit more electricity, so it's best to use it when you're in a hurry.) The dishes from grilling pork belly and kimchi yesterday came out sparkling clean. I pre-wash them before using it, and I use pocket detergent. Everything was handled well.
